scope: Full static review of specialist lifecycle, agent handoff and iteration contracts; lifecycle-contract.md remains only partially reviewed
review_notes: Independent leased attempts own scratch work; registration and termination require current tokens, with explicit recovery after loss.
Partial and failed outputs remain immutable; retries use new attempts and must not fabricate approvals or remote observations.
Recipe/source changes require a new run and fresh candidate validation/approval; dependency IDs, not filenames, define affected work.
Automatic dependency invalidation and real journey acceptance remain explicit unclosed requirements.
Receipt retention and independent backend retrieval stay separate from remote success and upload permission.
